test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If 13 September 2003 is a Saturday, then what will be the day of the week on 14 February 2005?
solution:
**Given : 13 September 2003 is a Saturday**

 
• Total number of days in a normal year = 365
 
• Total number of days in a leap year = 366
 
• Total number of odd days in a normal year = 365/7 = 1 
 
• Total number of odd days in a leap year = 366/7 = 2
 
• 13 September 2003 (Saturday) + 2 odd days = 13 September 2004 (Monday)
 
• Total number of days from 13 September 2004 to 14 February 2005 = 17 (September) + 31 (October) + 30 (November) + 31 (December) + 31 (January) + 14 (February) = 154
 
• Total number of odd days from 13 September 2004 to 14 February 2005 = 154/7 = 0
 
• Starting from 13 September 2004, every 7th day will be Monday.
 
• Since there is no odd day between 13 September 2004 and 14 February 2005, so **14 February 2005 will be held on Monday**.

Hence,** 'option 3'** is the correct answer.
